title: 4.89kg ! Evolve Cima Weight Weenie Build. #PandaPodium

takeaways.text: A brand-built showcase CIMA (not the presenter's size) with Dura-Ace Di2 2×, 885 g prototype wheels, 25 mm clinchers, pedals, cages and mount weighed 4.89 kg; the presenter's store sells Evolve and the wheels are his own brand.
Repeats Evolve's figure of about 650 g for an unpainted size-M frame, plus roughly 45 g of paint; the frame was not weighed separately.
On a short ride it felt extremely nimble and eager on climbs, with the front lifting on steep pitches; the bike was not set up for the presenter, so fit was off.

disclosure: The description links the CIMA Speed Artist and promotes parts sold by Panda Podium; this is retailer-linked build context.
summary: Lightweight CIMA road build with a component walkthrough and ride discussion. The title's weight belongs to the shown custom build, not a factory configuration or this candidate's package.
